risk_summary: The disclosure reports declining sales, profitability, operating margins, and a sharply higher effective tax rate, while identifying persistent COVID-19, supply-chain, inflation, and component-availability risks. Management provides quantified historical results and some 2023 investment estimates, but relies heavily on forward-looking conditional language and broad mitigation plans. Liquidity appears supported by operating cash flow and borrowing capacity, though continued disruptions and reliance on credit remain material risks.
